events.title: A History of the Future
events.venue: Manx Museum, Douglas, Isle of Man
events.description: What could life on our Island look like in 2050? Step into A History of the Future: Skeealyn y Vairagh , a unique, large-scale artwork inspired by the voices, ideas and imaginations of hundreds of young people from across the Isle of Man. Through a colourful graphic artwork and twelve original audio stories, you will meet the locals living, learning, working and playing in a thriving future where warm homes, healthy coastlines, local food, flourishing wildlife and connected communities are part of everyday Manx life. Look closely and you may even discover some wonderfully imaginative ideas, from a pollution-clearing sky vacuum to an Island-wide composting service. events.description: The Nature Exploratorium A fresh new adventure has arrived at the Manx Museum’s popular play gallery.
